function.name: read_pdf
function.description: Read a PDF file and return extracted text for a selected page.

path.description: Absolute path to the PDF file.

page.description: Page number to read, starting from 1.

function.name: read_image
function.description: Read an image file and return it in a format compatible with the model.

path.description: Absolute path to the image file. Supported: png, jpg, jpeg.

function.name: read_plain_text
function.description: Read plain text from a file with optional line-range selection.

path.description: Absolute path to the text file.

function.name: read_csv
function.description: Read a CSV file and convert it into a markdown-like table for the model.

path.description: Absolute path to the CSV file.

max_rows.description: Maximum number of rows to display in the converted table.

function.name: find_in_file
function.description: Search for a text query inside a file and return matching lines.

path.description: Absolute path to the file to search.

query.description: Text to find inside the file.

case_sensitive.description: Whether the search should be case-sensitive.

function.name: read_json
function.description: Read and return JSON content from a file in a readable text format.

path.description: Absolute path to the JSON file.

function.name: read_docx
function.description: Read the text content from a DOCX file.

path.description: Absolute path to the DOCX file.
